notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 2024.04+1
notes.notes:
Meet Boo

This update introduces a new singleplayer companion, Boo.
When exploring the skies alone, Boo will join your crew during the first region.
You can aks Boo to help out around the ship by using the emote wheel.

Smaller Improvements
This update further bings a whole lot of smaller improvements, bug fixes, and adjustments.
